phases.criterion: The approved strategy, immutable thresholds, negative invariants, and mutation guards pass before behavior changes.
Adoption emits source-backed conditional context views whose freshness is validated and whose authority is derived-only.
A reproducible captured run and a PIV-lite route reuse the existing lifecycle and completion authority.
Default-off incremental diagnostics meet the frozen latency/noise thresholds and remain advisory.
Three fresh-session isolated pilots pass with exact-candidate receipts and no shared mutable fallback.
A frozen demand gate returns activated or not_activated; only an activated gate requires provider-neutral Python and TypeScript semantic navigation with honest degradation.
Every phase and the existing host, harness, quality, and regression gates pass on one exact release candidate.
